elements.description:
An advisory with an answer: the request falls where the AI is only partly proven (amber) or not proven (red) – the
task area, a capped confidence, who was notified, and a folded distance-from-usual score.

properties.name: level
properties.description: How proven the AI is for this request: "partial" (amber) or "unproven" (red)

properties.name: area
properties.description: The task area the request falls in, by the name people know it by

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading – what to do about the answer: "Check this answer independently" or "Treat this answer as a starting point" by default

properties.name: message
properties.description: Why – a sentence on how proven the AI is here; a default sentence per level

properties.name: cap
properties.description: The highest confidence the answer may show, e.g. "Medium"; set, the notice says "Confidence capped at …"

properties.name: notified
properties.description: Who was told about the request, e.g. "Supervisor"; set, the notice says "… notified"

properties.name: distance
properties.description: How far the request is from the ones the AI usually handles; set, the notice has a folded detail with a scale

properties.name: usual
properties.description: The score above which a request counts as unusual – marked on the scale, the usual range shaded below it

properties.name: scaleMin
properties.description: The low end of the scale

properties.name: scaleMax
properties.description: The high end of the scale

properties.name: digits
properties.description: Decimal places the score is shown with

properties.name: distanceLabel
properties.description: The name of the score – the toggle's label and the scale's name

properties.name: distanceNote
properties.default: "How far this request is from the ones the AI usually handles. Higher means less familiar."
properties.description: A sentence under the scale saying what the score means

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the distance detail is open

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The distance detail was opened or closed; detail `{ open }`: CapabilityOpenChange. Cancelable.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – what to do about the answer: "Check this answer independently" or "Treat this answer as a starting point" by default

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the distance detail is open. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the detail starts open when uncontrolled – folded by default

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The distance detail was opened or closed

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – what to do about the answer: "Check this answer independently" or "Treat this answer as a starting point" by default

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the distance detail is open. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the detail starts open when uncontrolled – folded by default

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The distance detail was opened or closed

hides: Treat this answer as a starting point

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - `tc-agreement-tracker`, `tc-confidence-brief`, `tc-capability-notice`, `tc-transcript-review`, `tc-version-history`, `tc-session-context-bar`, `tc-evidence-coverage`, `tc-review-conflict`; - `tc-handoff-brief`, `tc-engagement-quality`, `tc-knowledge-promotion`, `tc-friction-profile`, `tc-reasoning-flags`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
